JOYSTAR Macarons Girls Rainbow Bike - Sizes 12" to 16"
Brighten up her world with the JOYSTAR Macarons Girls Bike. Featuring a vibrant rainbow-inspired design and a sweet macaron color palette, this bike is the perfect companion for girls aged 2-7 to explore the neighborhood with confidence and style.

Vibrant colors meet reliable safety: The JOYSTAR Macaron in Rainbow Color.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Engineered for safety and joy, the Macaron features a sturdy frame and an easy-to-use braking system designed specifically for young riders."
Superior Safety Systems
The JOYSTAR Macaron is built with a sturdy Hi-Ten steel frame and fork, designed to survive the multiple bumps of learning balance. For intuitive stopping power, it features a rear coaster brake—little riders simply need to pedal backward to stop. An enclosed chain guard prevents clothing and fingers from getting caught, ensuring every ride is worry-free.

Full control with an easy-to-use coaster brake and protective chain guard.

Key Features & Benefits

Growth-Ready: Features an adjustable saddle and stem height to ensure the perfect fit as your child grows.

Stable Learning: Includes heavy-duty removable training wheels to keep the bike upright until she is ready to balance on her own.

Smooth Ride: Wrapped in resilient rubber pneumatic tires for outstanding grip and stability in various weather conditions.

Fun Accessories: Comes with a beautiful front basket and DIY decal stickers for a personalized look.

Quick & Easy Assembly
We make it easy to get riding. The JOYSTAR Macaron arrives 85% pre-assembled. With the basic tools and simple instructions included, you can have the bike ready for your little one's first adventure in no time.

Watch: Get your Macaron bike assembled and ready in minutes.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

See It In Action

Experience the joy: Watch the Macaron bike in action.

Our Guarantee
Safety is our priority. JOYSTAR stands behind every bike with a commitment to quality and support:

The Frame (Lifetime): Steel and aluminum frames are guaranteed against faulty materials and workmanship for as long as the original purchaser owns the bicycle.

The Components (2 Years): Most non-wear parts (such as the handlebars, fork, and crankset) are covered for 2 years against manufacturing defects.

Registration Bonus: While the standard warranty is robust, JOYSTAR often extends a Limited Lifetime Warranty to the original owner if the bike is registered on our official website shortly after purchase.

Customer Support: Our team is ready to assist with any issues or assembly questions to ensure a safe ride.
